layout.sidebar: Fixed left, glassmorphic or soft solid background, pill-shaped active states.
layout.dashboard_grid: Grid cols-1 md:cols-3 lg:cols-4 gap-6. Follow Control Room bento grid setup.
layout.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards to prevent text collision.

components.cards: Flat background or glassmorphic, rounded-2xl, subtle border, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300.
components.buttons: Primary buttons use primary color. rounded-xl. Hover: brightness-95.
components.tables: Shadcn Table, clean lines, no vertical borders, soft pastel hover states for rows.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input, rounded-xl, soft focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50).

animations.page_transitions: Framer motion fade in and slide up (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1)
animations.micro_interactions: Scale button 0.98 on tap, smooth hover on dashboard cards

login_background.description: Abstract elegant feminine background with soft pastel pink, nude, and gentle gold waves.

hero_cake.description: Beautifully decorated cake featuring pastel floral designs for empty states or welcome banners.

bakery_interior.description: Inviting bakery interior with pastel doors for settings or profile background context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements and key text have a data-testid attribute.
Implement a feminine dark mode using deep aubergine (#1A161C) rather than pure black.
Use Shadcn UI extensively but customize border radius to rounded-2xl or higher, and inject the pastel color palette.
Use Recharts for the Dashboard charts with the provided chart_palette.
Install Framer Motion for soft layout transitions.
Fonts: Import Cormorant Garamond (headings) and Outfit (body). Apply globally in Tailwind.
Avoid pure black/grey text; use the warm text colors defined.
